meta.title: CityMaster - Interactive Geography Game
meta.description: CityMaster - Educational and interactive geography game based on OpenStreetMap. Master your city map!

install_modal.title: Install CityMaster
install_modal.subtitle: Fast, lightweight & available offline
install_modal.ios_step_1: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari (square icon with an upward arrow).
install_modal.ios_step_2: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen" 📲.
install_modal.ios_step_3: Tap "Add" in the top right corner. The icon will appear on your home screen!
install_modal.android_step_1: Tap the ⋮ menu (three dots in the top right).
install_modal.android_step_2: Select "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
install_modal.desktop_step_1: Click the install icon on the right side of your browser's address bar.
install_modal.desktop_step_2: Click "Install" to launch CityMaster as a standalone application.
install_modal.footer_tip: No need to search the App Store or Google Play: CityMaster installs directly from your browser, free of ads and without cluttering your phone's storage.

legal.title: Legal Notice & Privacy Policy
legal.subtitle: Regulatory information, GDPR compliance, and map credits.
legal.editor_desc: CityMaster is an independent, interactive educational web mapping application, published by Alban Elie.
legal.hosting_desc: The application is hosted locally or on secure Cloud servers following modern security standards.
legal.credits_desc: Map data provided by OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL license). Tiles by Leaflet and Esri. Geospatial processing powered by Turf.js and Overpass API.
legal.rgpd_desc: CityMaster respects your privacy. No personal data is sold or shared with third parties. User preferences (language, theme, avatar, and scores) are stored securely in local browser storage (LocalStorage/application database). Under GDPR rules, you have the right to access, modify, or delete your data anytime upon request or via your profile.
legal.cookies_desc: CityMaster does not use advertising cookies or third-party tracking scripts. Technical local storage (LocalStorage) is strictly used to save your in-game preferences.
legal.a11y_desc: CityMaster is dedicated to digital accessibility in accordance with RGAA and WCAG 2.1 AA standards (keyboard navigation, high contrast ratios, ARIA semantic landmarks, and motion reduction). In case of accessibility barriers, please contact support.tsuki.dev@gmail.com.

landing.hero_title: Master the Geography of YOUR CITY
landing.hero_subtitle: Test your knowledge of streets, housing estates, and neighborhoods in real-time with OpenStreetMap.

landing.feature_3_desc: Play on smartphone, tablet, or desktop: installable in 1 tap without app stores and works offline.

support.title: Support the Project
support.subtitle: Independent & passionate development of CityMaster
support.welcome_intro: Welcome! CityMaster was initially created as an end-of-year academic project, and I have continued to develop it in my spare time out of pure passion.
support.welcome_costs: The game is completely free and ad-free. If you enjoy the game and want to support its evolution, you're in the right place!
support.contribute_desc: There's absolutely no obligation, but if you'd like to support the project, there are two great ways to participate:
support.way_kofi_desc: Support hosting with a voluntary donation (the price of a coffee) to help cover hardware, electricity, and map servers.
support.kofi_aria: Support CityMaster on Ko-fi (opens in a new tab)
support.way_mod_desc: Help us verify, fix, and validate street geometry and district data in your city to ensure seamless and bug-free rounds.
support.mod_aria: Apply as a cartographic moderator via email
